name: subscriptions
title: Subscriptions
description: One customer's ongoing agreement to a plan, and the record the period biller walks. billing_mode is carried explicitly rather than inferred from whether a plan happens to have a base price -- the predecessor learned this, offering wallet | subscription | hybrid as a stated choice, because 'guess the mode from the numbers' breaks the moment someone sells a zero-base plan with a real contract behind it. The status ladder is time-driven and belongs to the daemon (docs/logic-decisions.md #2): a trial ends, an unpaid invoice ages a subscription to past_due, continued non-payment suspends it. Those moves are declared transitions with guards, so a machine making them is held to the same rules a person is -- and every one lands in the change log with an actor, which is how 'why was I cut off?' has an answer.

fields.name: customer_name
fields.label: Customer Name
fields.help: Stamped at signup so an invoice reads correctly even if the contact is later renamed or removed.

fields.name: billing_mode
fields.label: Billing Mode
fields.help: wallet: pay-as-you-go from a prepaid balance, no periodic invoice. subscription: a flat fee each period. hybrid: the fee plus metered overage.

fields.name: wallet_id
fields.label: Wallet
fields.help: Which balance wallet-mode usage draws down.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.help: past_due -> active is deliberate and common: paying the invoice restores service, and the ladder must be climbable in both directions or a paying customer stays cut off. canceled is terminal -- resubscribing is a new agreement, not a resurrection.

fields.name: current_period_end
fields.label: Period End
fields.help: The biller closes a period once this date has passed, then advances both dates by the plan's period.

fields.name: cancel_at_period_end
fields.label: Cancel At Period End
fields.help: The honest way to cancel: service runs to the end of the paid period, then stops. Cutting service off the instant someone clicks cancel bills them for time they cannot use.

fields.name: external_ref
fields.label: Provider Reference
fields.help: The provider's subscription id when one exists. This server stays the system of record either way.
